notes.title: Side-scrolling, soul-shifting sandbox action adventure AMEDAMA—due for release in 2023!
notes.notes:
AMEDAMA is a side-scrolling, soul-shifting sandbox action adventure brought to life with a striking new 2D style!
Due for release on Steam in 2023! 

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38202714/734e5d3fd556510a9d9c28609ff87b6600b59448.jpg

AMEDAMA is a brand new game brought to you by IzanagiGames and ACQUIRE, with character design from lack (Fate/Grand Order, Touken Ranbu), and music from Yuko Komiyama (Monster Hunter series).

▼Add to your Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2411980/__AMEDAMA/

▼AMEDAMA global Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/amedama_global

Stay tuned for more announcements and updates!

notes.title: Update Released
notes.notes:
Hello,

The issues that some users were experiencing on specific PC environments have now been fixed and we have released an update.

Thank you for your patience and for your feedback.
We kindly ask that players update their game.

Thanks!

-IzanagiGames

notes.title: Update: 12/1/2021
notes.notes:
Hello,

We are aware that some users are experiencing issues on specific PC environments, and are currently investigating the issue. We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and thank you for your patience while we fix the issue.

Thank you to all those users who have posted specific feedback in the community hub. Your reports are extremely helpful, and help us pinpoint the issue.

When you leave feedback, if we could trouble you to let us know the following details, that would be highly appreciated.

- OS version
- The timing at which you encountered the issue
- Graphics card
- Processor
- RAM

Thank you.

-IzanagiGames
